overview.description: The 21Shares FTSE Crypto 10 ex-BTC Index ETF (TXBC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long cryptocurrency basket, short usd currency. The fund tracks an index of the top 10 crypto assets, excluding Bitcoin (BTC), selected and weighted by their market capitalization. The fund invests in crypto assets through ETFs, ETPs, and other financial instruments. TXBC was launched on Nov 13, 2025 and is issued by 21Shares.
